ns2:course.label: Jazz Dance I
ns2:course.description: Introduction to basic dance technique and stylistic work in the jazz idiom. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: For non-dance majors.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: For non-dance majors.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students with previous jazz dance experience should enroll in DANC 106. Student costs for supplies and concert tickets are approx. $30. Written assignments and concert attendance is required.
